# SiyaSphere

> SiyaSphere is a GTM and RevOps consultancy (Indore, India; serving clients worldwide) that fixes broken go-to-market systems for B2B SaaS companies. We design and implement RevOps frameworks, marketing automation, Salesforce and HubSpot architecture, lead routing, sales analytics, and AI-powered GTM workflows with human-in-the-loop review.

Engagements typically follow an 8-week process from GTM audit to launch, for B2B SaaS companies from roughly $2M to $100M+ ARR. A free 30-minute GTM audit is available at https://www.siyasphere.in/contact.

## Services

- [All GTM Solutions](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions)
- [RevOps Consulting & Transformation](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/revops-consulting): Align your entire GTM engine for predictable growth.
- [Lead Routing & Lead Data Quality](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/lead-routing): Every lead to the right rep, fast, with clean data.
- [Salesforce Consulting & Org Optimisation](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/salesforce-consulting): A Salesforce org your team actually wants to use.
- [GTM Data Migration & System Modernisation](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/crm-data-migration): Move fast without breaking anything.
- [Marketing Intelligence & Attribution](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/marketing-analytics-attribution): Know what works. Prove what matters.
- [Sales Intelligence & Forecasting](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/sales-analytics-forecasting): Empower reps to close more deals, faster.
- [Executive GTM Dashboards & Data Visualisation](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/gtm-dashboards): One source of truth for your entire GTM operation.
- [AI + Human Workflows for GTM](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/ai-gtm-workflows): Scale without sacrificing judgement.
- [AI-Powered GTM Tech Stack](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/ai-gtm-tech-stack): Modern GTM infrastructure, built for speed and reliability.
- [Account Intelligence & Prospect Research](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions/account-research-prospect-intelligence): Know your buyers before you reach out.
- [The Modern GTM Stack](https://www.siyasphere.in/gtm-stack): How SiyaSphere connects marketing automation, RevOps, and AI workflows into one go-to-market system
